results.question: Kaç müşteri var?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers LIMIT 1000

results.question: Enterprise segmentindeki müşterileri isimleriyle listele
results.generated_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM public.customers WHERE segment = 'Enterprise' ORDER BY customer_name LIMIT 50

results.question: Türkiye'deki müşteri sayısı kaç?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers WHERE country = 'TR' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Müşterileri segmentlerine göre sayar mısın?
results.generated_sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: Ülkelere göre müşteri sayısını çoktan aza sırala
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers AS c WHERE NOT c.country IS NULL GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

results.question: En pahalı ürünün adı ve fiyatı nedir?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.unit_price FROM public.products AS p ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Ürün kategorilerine göre ürün sayısı ve ortalama birim fiyat
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count, AVG(p.unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM analytics.products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

results.question: SKU-100 kodlu ürünün adı nedir?
results.generated_sql: SELECT product_name FROM public.products WHERE sku = 'SKU-100' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Birim fiyatı 2000 TL üzerindeki ürünleri listele
results.generated_sql: SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, category, unit_price FROM analytics.products WHERE unit_price > 2000 ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 50

results.question: Completed durumundaki sipariş sayısı
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM analytics.sales_orders WHERE LOWER(status) = 'completed' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Sipariş durumlarına göre sipariş adetleri
results.generated_sql: SELECT s.status, COUNT(s.order_id) AS order_count FROM analytics.sales_orders AS s GROUP BY s.status ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50
warnings: The query does not include a date filter. If the table is large, this may be slow. Consider adding a WHERE clause on order_date if a specific period is needed.

results.question: 2026 yılında verilen siparişlerin sayısı
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.sales_orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026 LIMIT 1000

results.question: Aylara göre sipariş sayısı (tarih sırasıyla)
results.generated_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS order_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.sales_orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2 ASC LIMIT 50

results.question: Toplam ciro nedir?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(soi.quantity * soi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM analytics.sales_order_items AS soi JOIN analytics.sales_orders AS so ON soi.order_id = so.order_id WHERE so.status ILIKE 'completed' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Müşteri bazında toplam ciroyu en yüksekten başlayarak ilk 3 müşteri
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity * soi.unit_price), 0) AS total_revenue FROM analytics.customers AS c LEFT JOIN analytics.sales_orders AS so ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id LEFT JOIN analytics.sales_order_items AS soi ON so.order_id = soi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: Ürün kategorisine göre toplam satış tutarı
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(soi.quantity * soi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM analytics.sales_order_items AS soi JOIN analytics.products AS p ON soi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN analytics.sales_orders AS so ON soi.order_id = so.order_id WHERE so.order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

results.question: Segmentlere göre toplam ciro
results.generated_sql: SELECT segment, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM public.v_order_revenue GROUP BY segment ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: Cirosu 20000 TL üzerinde olan müşteriler
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(soi.quantity * soi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM analytics.sales_orders AS so JOIN analytics.sales_order_items AS soi ON so.order_id = soi.order_id JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE so.currency ILIKE 'tl' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(soi.quantity * soi.unit_price) > 20000 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 50
warnings: Currency sütunundaki tam değer bilinmemektedir (örn: 'TRY', 'TL', 'Turkish Lira'). 'tl' ILIKE filtresi yaygın varyasyonları yakalamayı amaçlar.
İade (returns) veya iptal (status) durumları bu sorguda dikkate alınmamıştır. Sadece kayıtlı sipariş kalemleri baz alınmıştır.

results.question: Hiç sipariş vermemiş müşteriler var mı, isimleri neler?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM analytics.customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics.sales_orders AS so WHERE so.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.customer_name LIMIT 50

results.question: En çok adet satılan ürün hangisi?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(s.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM analytics.sales_order_items AS s JOIN analytics.products AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id JOIN analytics.sales_orders AS so ON s.order_id = so.order_id WHERE so.order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Açık faturaların toplam kalan tutarı ne kadar?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(remaining_amount) AS total_remaining_amount FROM analytics.invoices WHERE status ILIKE 'open' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Fatura durumlarına göre fatura adedi ve brüt tutar toplamı
results.generated_sql: SELECT i.status, COUNT(i.invoice_id) AS invoice_count, SUM(i.gross_amount) AS total_gross_amount FROM analytics.invoices AS i GROUP BY i.status ORDER BY i.status LIMIT 1000

results.question: Vadesi geçmiş faturaları listele
results.generated_sql: SELECT i.invoice_id, i.invoice_date, i.due_date, i.gross_amount, i.remaining_amount, i.status, i.currency, i.order_id FROM analytics.invoices AS i WHERE i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND i.remaining_amount > 0 ORDER BY i.due_date ASC LIMIT 50

results.question: Toplam tahsilat tutarı nedir?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_collection FROM public.payments LIMIT 1000

results.question: Faturası olan müşterilerin adları ve fatura brüt tutarları
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, i.gross_amount FROM analytics.invoices AS i JOIN analytics.orders AS o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LIMIT 50

results.question: Şubeleri şehirleriyle birlikte şirket adına göre listele
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.company_name, b.city FROM analytics.branches AS b JOIN analytics.companies AS c ON b.company_id = c.company_id ORDER BY c.company_name, b.city LIMIT 50

results.question: Şehirlere göre müşteri adresi sayısı
results.generated_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM analytics.customer_addresses GROUP BY city ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50
